messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High RPM detected for model family arkose-11b (5m avg RPM=420, anomaly score=9.3). Autosculpt attempted and returned partial success; some shards still saturated. Graph: https://internal.metrics/arkose-11b/rpm?u=oncall

incident-bot: Triggered runbook: live-rate-sculpt -> recommend per-model RPM reduction and function-call disable for public scope.

dana_oncall: I'm on it. Quick context: looks like an external customer (game-studio-alf) started a large stress test hitting arkose-11b endpoints with long context prompts + tool calls. Non-enterprise traffic is the lion's share. Priorities: 1) reduce public RPM, 2) disable function-calls for arkose-11b, 3) route high-retry traffic to arkose-11b-lite if available.

sam_infra: ETA to apply per-model RPM change is ~30s once command is run. Are we capping RPM or TPS? I suggest RPM first because bursts are causing accounting spikes.

maria_sre: FYI metrics — p95 latency for arkose-11b jumped 2.2x, 5xx rate up from 0.2% -> 3.1% in last 10m. CPU on pooled inferencers at 86% on region-us-west-2. If we don't shape, we'll hit circuit limits and more customer impact.

dana_oncall: I'll apply an immediate cap for public (non-enterprise) traffic to 60 RPM and enable fallback routing for tiered customers. Running commands now:

```
# limit public RPM for arkose-11b
/admin quota set --model arkose-11b --scope public --rpm 60 --note "auto-mitigate 3241200000"
# disable function-calls for arkose-11b family
/admin model-config update --model arkose-11b --feature function_calls=false
# add fallback route to arkose-11b-lite (30% of traffic)
/routing create --from arkose-11b --to arkose-11b-lite --pct 30 --ttl 10m
```

system: command accepted: quota update queued -> applied to edge nodes within ~45s.

dana_oncall: Quota set confirmed. Function-calls disabled confirmed. Fallback route created and initial 30% traffic diverted to arkose-11b-lite-quant. Monitoring now.

sam_infra: Nice. Can you also flip on the soft circuit breaker with a short TTL so we auto-unwind? Command:

```
/admin circuit-breaker set --model arkose-11b --threshold 5%_500s --ttl 15m --action reject
```

maria_sre: Circuit breaker enabled. Observing immediate drop in 5xxs from 3.1% -> 1.0% after routing change. Latency p95 trending down but still elevated compared to baseline.

kai_prodops: What's customer impact? Any paying customers affected badly? Need to decide on external comms.

dana_oncall: Initial triage:
- Enterprise / reserved customers: heavy calls redirected successfully; retries succeeded for ~98% of requests. No major enterprise errors reported yet (monitoring SM ok).
- Free / public: ~8% of requests saw 503s during spike window, mostly before measures. Post-mitigation failures are under 1.5% and falling.
- Top 10 API keys by volume are mostly internal test keys and game-studio-alf.

support-bot: Creating incident ticket and status page draft -> INC-324120-ARKOSE. Notifying #support with summary and suggested customer message.

support-bot: Suggested status text draft: "We are investigating degraded performance for arkose-11b model family. Mitigations in place; impacted customers may see increased latency or transient errors. Engineers are monitoring; updates every 15 minutes."

kai_prodops: OK send the status page but mark as "degraded performance" not outage. Keep enterprise notice private for now.

maria_sre: Ops note / playbook for handoff:
- continue monitoring edges and p95/p99 latency (us-west-2 & eu-west-1)
- keep RPM cap at 60 for public for next 10m, then evaluate auto-lift to 120 if stable
- keep function_calls disabled for 30m and run smoke tests against arkose-11b-lite fallback
- verify billing/logging tags for diverted traffic

maria_sre: Handoff to oncall-next @maria_sre (I'm taking the next shift). Dana, leave me the runbook steps you've done and any in-flight tickets.

maria_sre: I'll monitor for 60 minutes and escalate if error rate rises >1.5% or p95 > 2x baseline.

dana_oncall: Done — left runbook notes in INC-324120-ARKOSE ticket, included commands run + timestamps, and the top offending API keys. Handing to @maria_sre. :white_check_mark: I'll go offline in 10 to let you take it.

incident-bot: Incident update logged: mitigation applied: public RPM capped to 60; function-calls disabled for arkose-11b; 30% traffic routed to arkose-11b-lite. Next update scheduled in 15m.

support-bot: Public status page posted (short update). Support team notified and draft customer messages prepared.

maria_sre: Thanks all — monitoring now. Will post final post-mortem + timeline in #postmortems if we need deeper follow-up.
